Sitting down on my favourite bean bag chair in my room.

It's exactly 19:48, November 12th, 2013. It has been 2 minutes and 26 seconds since I ingested the substance, Psilocybe cubensis "Z-Strain;" taking 3.5 grams as a tea with Splenda(?) sweetener. Did not taste awful.

It should be noted that at 16:00 I ate a light dinner.

3 friends join me, coming from the kitchen taking their own doses. None of us has tripped before.

"This is going to be awesome, " says one of my friends.

19:50

They had been with me since earlier today. We played basketball, then they joined my family for dinner. My parents have been out since the dinner, and will likely be out until much later. My siblings are also already asleep, so there should not be anything to disturb us.

I would say I am beginning to feel the effects, but I am doubting the legitimacy of such claim. Placebos can convince even the most diligent.

It has been a little while since anyone has said anything.

I feel a slight tingling behind my eyes and I find it difficult to rest them on any single thing longer than a second or two. They linger along the walls; scanning the imperfections accumulated through the years and a patchwork of paint jobs.

They seem so empty. The eggshell white holds nothing but flaws I had inflicted on it. It would be clean without me. Should I regret the scuffles my friends and I enjoyed?

No. I don't really care. Nothing ever stays unmarked by the world. It affects you whether you want it to or not. You can think the world inflicts flaws, or your body and soul can be a portrait painted with each brush stroke a scar that you bear ever more proudly through your survival.

19:59

I sighed. I don't often sigh. It's an unassuming and ambiguous gesture. It confuses me when I do it. It confuses me when people do it. Why are they sighing? Is something wrong? Is something exasperating? Are they tired? Sad? Confused? Frustrated? Happy?

I try not to sigh.

I do it again, moving along the walls with my eyes. They stop at my painting. I remember every stroke it took. Every mixing of paint, ever late night, every attempt it took to be perfect.

I sigh a third time. I can't show people these. I can't tell them they're mine. They would laugh. It's nothing good. They would laugh at how long it took me. They would laugh at how hard I tried. They would laugh at the fact that I hung it up in my own room.

Arrogant, useless, prick.

It's a reminder though. To something I love doing, but can't because it doesn't make me money; it's not a real job; I have no talent.

What am I saying? I don't really believe that about myself, do I?

No talent? Dedication is talent enough. Fuck your opinion. It makes me happy. That's all that matters. That's all that should matter.

20:10

Just noticing now - my fingers are moving without my conscious thought. How odd. I can never type without looking, normally. I don't remember typing as much as I have, frankly. I don't think my fingers can keep up with my thoughts either.

How long have I been standing for? Why haven't my friends said anything about it? It doesn't really matter. I sit back down.

The bean bag is so much more comfortable the second time around. I feel sweat trailing down my back. I feel every heart beat through my ears. The repetitions sing a lullaby for me.

The tell - tale heart doesn't make me feel the need to scratch at the floor. I want to yell. I want to tell scream. I want to speak, cry, laugh, and smile.

I just want to feel something other than this hurt.

I need to walk. I walk. Before I know it, I'm out the front door.

It's bloody freezing. I go back inside and get my jacket. Oh, and my keys. Wouldn't want to ring the doorbell late at night. That would be a bummer; being yelled at by my parents. Fucking hell, it's cold.

It feels great.

20:40

I walk to the barn. It's warmer there. My car is there. I open it up. I toss my keys somewhere by the door and get in the backseat.

The cold leather sticks to my cheek as I lay facedown.

My eyes are tired. I close my eyes. I see myself back in my room, without all my friends in there. The walls are black. Ink black. They're getting darker.

The walls stop getting darker. I stare at the abyss surrounding me. I can see letters, jumbled on top of each other. It's weird.

"It's weird, " crisply written in ink forms in front of my eyes. I stop thinking.

I can read sentences off the walls, now that I'm not so busy thinking. Wow, it feels good not thinking.

I'm reading now. It's like every thought I had ever had in my room was written on the walls. A lot of it isn't in my writing.

Who takes notes on my thoughts?

"We do."

My eyes snap open as the voices answer me.

"We do," they repeat and I imagine two forms growing out of the darkness of the barn walls.

I look at them, surprised as to whom I'm seeing: my chubby self at 10 years old and an apparent future version of me.

"I write whenever you have a childish thought, " little me says.

"And I write whenever you're being mature." older me says.

Well shit. That's pretty fucking weird.

My writing gets worse as I get older.

21:33

I say good bye to them. I get up. I get out of the car. I find my keys on the floor. I walk back to my room. My friends are laughing at the moment. I laugh with them.

I like laughing. It makes me feel better. I don't even remember why I wouldn't feel great.

I sit back in my bean bag chair. I start thinking about my friends from school.

[N]is kind of a dick but he's really funny most of the time. He started shit with [B] but it was funny then but we regret it now because it's like an opportunity lost.

[Y] is really sassy to me, but she's basically my twin. It's weird knowing someone else that is so much like you. We sort of repel each other like like-charges. It would make me really happy if she and I could just be together, but I'm too much of a wuss to potentially ruin a good friendship with a relationship that's could be filled with so many obstacles.

I'm so jealous of [R]. He's like good at everything. Except reading people. I'm usually quieter around him, so I think he thinks I don't like him. We just don't have a lot in common. I wouldn't blame him for disliking me, but I really don't think he should just yet. I haven't even done much wrong.

[A] is really funny and upbeat. She makes me smile, and it great having a friend like her when I'm having bad days. She says kind of ditzy things sometimes, but it just adds to her charm.

[CG] is really loud and opinionated, which is fun. She's also really comfortable with herself and really supportive. It's awesome having people I can talk to about embarrassing stuff without being judged.

[CB] is the nicest guy of the bunch. He gets a lot of flak for being interested more in drugs than the rest of us. He's probably the most relatable to me. He's probably my best friend among us.

My friends are looking at me. They laugh again. I feel like they're laughing at me. I laugh along.

If you can't laugh at yourself, you shouldn't laugh at anyone else.

We settle down.

I sit there with my mind turned off, looking at the ceiling as it waves back and forth.

22:23

I feel on top of the world.

I start reading the walls again. It's weird being able to stop thinking when you don't want to anymore. It's really relaxing. I wonder if other people can do it. I wonder if I can do it later.

The words come off the walls as I read them. They fall through the floor and I think they dissolve into nothingness.

Some of it hurts to read. Most of it I'm embarrassed of. A little of it makes me happy.

Bugger me if I'm going to not learn from this.

21:08

It hurts reading about my ex. But I as I recall our relationship... I realise I can't get mad at her. I can get mad at things she's done and said... But I can't get mad at how she feels.

Maybe she did love me throughout parts of the relationship, but her feelings changed. I can't blame her for how she feels. It would have been nice to not have been strung along for that long, but at least I got my heart break out of the way. Everyone should get their heart broken. It makes your stronger.

I have an anger issue. Not in the traditional sense, but I do have one. I pent up and store away all my anger to be dealt with at a later date. Usually at the dojo or the gym or something physical. I can't do that.

It makes me likely to explode at someone who metaphorically breaks the camel's back. Or I take it out by being maliciously sarcastic. That's not fair to those who don't deserve it. And since I'm not a deity, I can't determine who deserves it or not so no one deserves it.

I want to be a better person.

I want to look better, so I go to the gym. I want to feel better, so I eat healthy(ish). I want to be smarter, so I read more. I study more. I ask more questions. I want to be nicer, so I say less. I think before I do speak.

Every thought I had on my walls is gone. They're egg white now, even with my eyes closed; except for the marks and scrapes time gave them.

It's clean.

I take a pencil and write, "If everything isn't okay now, it will be."

It's messier than my normal writing.

21:40

I remember [CB] would want to know how my trip went. I text him. He's happy. I like when people are happy. I wish I could make people happy all the time.

I get up. My friends seem like they're sleeping. It seems early. We did have a long day. I get my headphones. I put music on, like [CB] said to.

Wow, this is great. I turn my mind back off so I can listen to the music.

22:45

I can't believe I just listened to music for the past however long. A lot of times has passed. I can feel myself coming to. It's beginning to get easier to concentrate. I don't mind the sobriety.

22:53 Official End of Trip.

I am drained. I did not, physically, do much at all. I can still turn my thoughts off. I wonder how long that will last. I'm going to bed now; everyone else is already asleep.
